This project, "Internal Process Optimization for New Technology Application", was initiated to address significant inefficiencies in launching digital projects at Roche.

Problem: The current implementation of a single digital project is overly complex, involving 5 departments, 22 process nodes, and 11 separate SOPs. This complexity creates an "information fog" for Project Managers who must coordinate with IT & Data Security , Procurement , and Legal & Compliance.





Key Challenges:


Exploratory Nature: New technology projects are innovative, making traditional project experience difficult to reuse.


Lack of Agility: The traditional, linear "waterfall" process is too slow and rigid for the agile execution these projects require.


Inefficiency: High cross-departmental communication costs and a lack of standardized guidelines mean teams "reinvent the wheel".



Unpredictable Timelines: Key process nodes are difficult to estimate, ranging from one week to several months, putting project deadlines at risk.

Objective: To accelerate this process, a cross-functional squad team was formed with COC support , bringing together members from all key departments to optimize the workflow

items.description:
Im NSCLC ist Tecentriq eine zentrale Säule der Immuntherapie von Roche, die über verschiedene Krankheitsstadien und Therapielinien hinweg eingesetzt wird. Es ist der "Backbone" für Roches Strategie in der häufigsten Form des Lungenkrebses.
Das strategische Ziel ist die Maximierung des Wertes von Tecentriq als DA-Anker im größten und kompetitivsten Onkologie-Markt.
Konkret bedeutet das:
1. Marktdurchdringung über alle Stadien: Etablierung von Tecentriq als Standard im metastasierten Setting (in unseren Fokussegmenten).
2. Verteidigung der Marktanteile: Sich in einem intensiven Wettbewerbsumfeld (gegen andere Checkpoint-Inhibitoren) durch ein breites Indikationsprofil und starke klinische Daten zu behaupten und zu differenzieren.

In NSCLC, Tecentriq serves as a central pillar of Roche's immunotherapy portfolio, utilized across various disease stages and lines of therapy. It acts as the backbone of Roche's strategy in the most common form of lung cancer. The strategic objective is to maximize the value of Tecentriq as a DA anchor within the largest and most competitive oncology market.

In concrete terms, this involves achieving market penetration across all stages by establishing Tecentriq as the standard in the metastatic setting within our focus segments. Furthermore, it requires defending market share in an intense competitive environment against other checkpoint inhibitors by differentiating through a broad indication profile and robust clinical data.

items.description:
The concept illustrated here represents an initiative for the strategic review and optimization of Therapeutic Area Expert (TAE) management in thoracic oncology. At the core of this initiative is the further development of our relationship with TAEs—evolving from a purely clinical data-driven exchange toward a strategic partnership.

This transformation is built upon several key pillars: First, internal process optimization aims to improve coordination to reduce the "mental load" for TAEs and to professionalize our engagement. Second, we are fostering a strategic dialogue by actively identifying forward-looking, healthcare-relevant topics directly with top experts, such as envisioning the landscape of the lung cancer market five years from now. Finally, the initiative focuses on support and development by identifying "Young TAEs" to establish early-stage strategic partnerships.

The overarching goal is to solidify Roche’s perception as a leading and indispensable partner in thoracic oncology—one that thinks far beyond mere product data.
items.realizedHWWK:

- Erhöhte Engagement-Tiefe: TAEs sind bereit, sich in anspruchsvolleren Formaten zu engagieren, die über ein klassisches Advisory Board hinausgehen (z.B. Co-Creation-Workshops, gemeinsame Publikationen zu Versorgungsthemen).
- "Word of Mouth": Sie erfahren von neuen Kontakten oder Kollegen, dass ein Top-TAE die herausragende und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit Roche lobend erwähnt hat.

Monitorierung unserer Geschäftstätigkeiten, insbes. auf Basis von Wachstumsfeldern und definierten KPIs, und Ableitung klarer Insights zur Beurteilung der Situation von Roche und Vabysmo im Wettbewerb. Dies gliedert sich in sechs workstreams: 
(1) Insights Prozess, (2) CI Prozess, (3) Biosimiliar Monitoring, (4) Regionaldaten und Segmente, (5) Marktdaten, Shares, Sales, (6) compounder Daten und kaufende Kunden
In den workstreams nutzen und konsolidieren wir multiple Datenquellen (z.B. Marktforschung, CI Informationen, Kundenfeedback, CRM, Segmentierungsdaten), um zielgerichtete Analysen bereitzustellen. Die gewonnenen Insights als Action Items aufbereitet, die für die relevanten Stakeholder implementierbar sind und zur Information / Entscheidung ins Squad eingebracht werden.
Monitoring our business activities, especially based on growth fields and defined KPIs (Key Performance Indicators), and deriving clear insights for assessing the competitive situation of Roche and Vabysmo. This is structured into six workstreams:

(1) Insights Process, (2) CI Process (Competitive Intelligence), (3) Biosimilar Monitoring, (4) Regional Data and Segments, (5) Market Data, Shares, Sales, (6) Compounder Data and Purchasing Customers.

In these workstreams, we utilize and consolidate multiple data sources (e.g., market research, CI information, customer feedback, CRM, segmentation data) to provide targeted analyses. The resulting insights are prepared as Action Items that are implementable for the relevant stakeholders and are brought into the Squad for information/decision-making.

Based on data (including Brand Equity Analysis, Ophtha-Panels) and thanks to efficient CI (Competitive Intelligence) Monitoring, we identify competitor strategies and optimization potential early on. Through efficient collaboration between the I-Team (Insights Team/Internal Team), Comms Team, and Omnichannel Team, we successfully manage and further develop our superior brand messages and differentiation concepts throughout the year.

The core goal is the establishment of Omnichannel Excellence to position Roche as a relevant, reliable, and proactive partner. All communication activities and campaign materials are cross-channel networked and consistently rolled out along the Adoption Ladder to embed the perception of Vabysmo as the favorite product with the best therapeutic success.

items.description:
Development of a comprehensive Evrysdi story that positions Evrysdi's effectiveness as a systemic therapy extending beyond purely motor function. This story is complemented by portraying SMA as a multisystem disease. The narrative shifts from "We measure movement" to "Beyond motor function: Multisystem therapy for life." It reinforces Evrysdi's differentiation by demonstrating its effectiveness in areas such as swallowing, speech, respiration, and cognition, positioning the medication as a holistic therapeutic approach—not just a motor therapy.

This story serves as a strategic foundation for future communications from the NMD team and aims to firmly establish the perception of SMA as a multisystem disease. This will strengthen Evrysdi's comprehensive effectiveness among neurologists, neuropediatricians, patients, and their families, in comparison to Spinraza, Zolgensma, and Itvisma.

items.description: Overarching Element for eg. WEFRA; Retainer etc.

Wir erweitern unsere Kundeninteraktion über rein wissenschaftliche Daten hinaus und setzen auf emotionale Differenzierung. Durch gezieltes Storytelling rahmen wir die starke Wirksamkeit von OCREVUS als sichere, ausgewogene und schützende Langzeittherapie, die eine maximale therapiefreie Zeit ermöglicht, und schaffen so das Vertrauen für OCREVUS als beste First Line Therapie.

Wir nutzen und generieren gezielt Evidenz, die OCREVUS von Mitbewerbern über ein starkes Narrativ differenziert und den Einsatz in der 1st Line (inkl. Retention und ggf. Deeskalation) unterstützt. Dafür setzen wir bereits vorhandene Daten effektiv und vollumfänglich ein. Gleichzeitig identifizieren und adressieren wir neue Evidenz-Gaps durch lokale, innovative und schnelle Evidenz-Generierung zusammen mit HCPs.

Wir generieren kontinuierlich Insights zu Marktdynamiken und Kundenwahrnehmung, um unseren Erfolg am Markt zu überprüfen, die 1st Line Positionierung von OCREVUS zu schärfen und Strategie / Taktiken bei Bedarf anzupassen. Durch gezieltes Wettbewerbs-Monitoring erkennen wir Markt- risiken frühzeitig, antizipieren Aktivitäten der Mitbewerber und können diese proaktiv adressieren.

Wir informieren und befähigen neudiagnostizierte MS-Patient:innen, den Mehrwert einer hocheffektiven Therapie direkt nach Diagnose mit nur zwei Applikationen pro Jahr zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit ihrem Behandlungsteam sich aktiv für die passende Erstlinientherapie zu entscheiden.

Wir informieren Nurses über die Vorteile einer frühzeitigen, hocheffektiven Therapie, befähigen sie zum Einsatz von OCREVUS und aktivieren sie dazu, die gemeinsame Entscheidungsfindung mit Arzt und Patient zu unterstützen.

Wir vermitteln Neurolog:innen transparent den Mehrwert einer zweimal jährlichen s.c. Gabe, mit Fokus auf Einfachheit, Zeitersparnis und die Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen. Durch sachbezogene Schulungen der MS Nurses sowie das gemeinsame Identifizieren und Lösen von praxisspezifischen Hürden befähigen wir Behandlungsteams zur sicheren Integration von OCREVUS s.c. in den Alltag. Den Patient:innen stellen wir dabei unterstützende neutrale Informationsmaterialien zur Seite.

Wir schaffen die Voraussetzungen für einen erfolgreichen OBI Launch in Q1.2028. Dafür entwickeln wir ein klares Zielbild für die zukünftige OBI-Nutzung, identifizieren und adressieren relevante Bedürfnisse und Hürden auf Basis wissenschaftlicher Evidenz sowie emotionaler Argumente und bereiten Teams, Prozesse und Maßnahmen so vor, dass wir zum Launch in Q1.2028 schnell und konsistent in die Umsetzung gehen können.

items.itemName: WP_DA_MS:WP_2027_08_[Financial security at the moment of truth]
items.description:
Wir bauen wirtschaftlich bedingte Verunsicherung in der Verordnungsentscheidung ab, verbessern die Vergütungsbedingungen für die Gabe von OCREVUS s.c. und unterstützen die Wirtschaftlichkeit von OCREVUS im Krankenhaus durch gezielte IVKs.
Mit der Neuverhandlung des Erstattungsbetrags sichern wir eine nachhaltige Erstattungsbasis für OCREVUS. Für POMS schaffen wir über Nutzenbewertung und Preisverhandlung die Voraussetzungen für einen nachhaltigen Zugang.

Aus Daten leiten wir präzise Kundensegmentierungen und personalisierte Customer-Engagement-Pläne ab. Darauf basierend orchestrieren wir eine nahtlose Omnichannel-Kommunikation: Mit der passenden Botschaft, über den relevanten Touchpoint und mit hoher Frequenz. So schaffen wir eine qualitativ und quantitativ starke Präsenz und übersetzen zielgerichtetes Customer Engagement direkt in eine tiefe Überzeugung für und die gezielte Verordnung von OCREVUS.

items.itemName: WP_DA_MS:WP_2027_10_[Compete to Win Selling Skills & CFF Effectiveness]
items.description:
Wir maximieren unseren Impact beim Kunden und bewirken Denk-und Verhaltensänderungen: 
Dazu entwickeln wir die Fähigkeit unseres Customer-Facing Teams kontinuierlich weiter, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden treffsicher zu analysieren, überzeugende fachliche sowie emotionale Argumente zum richtigen Zeitpunkt zu platzieren und die Kund:innen aktiv ins Handeln zu bringen. So wandeln wir mögliche Bedenken oder passive Zustimmung in proaktive Verordnungen für OCREVUS (1st Line und s.c.) um. Unsere Kundeninteraktionen sind optimal geplant und umgesetzt. Die Dialog Coverage halten wir kontinuierlich hoch und steigern sie im Vergleich zum Vorjahr.

Wir stärken die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit TAEs, um den 1L-Einsatz von OCREVUS sowie die s.c.-Adoption gemeinsam aktiv voranzutreiben. Indem wir außerdem frühzeitig Innovationen wie den OBI, Fenebrutinib und unsere breite Pipeline in ein gemeinsames Zukunftsbild der MS-Versorgung integrieren, entwickeln wir unsere TAEs zu starken Advokaten, die Roches aktuelles und zukünftiges Portfolio proaktiv und eigenständig auf Kongressen und Fortbildungen überzeugend vertreten.

Wir schaffen neue, inspirierende Erlebnisse auf Kongressen und Events, die die Differenzierung von Roche und OCREVUS gegenüber dem Wettbewerb nachhaltig verankern, den Dialog mit unseren Neurolog:innen, Nurses und Patient:innen stärken und unsere Innovationskraft demonstrieren. So vertiefen wir die Partnerschaft mit Roche und stärken den Einsatz von OCREVUS (1L und s.c.) nachhaltig.

This Work Package is an exploratory piece of work designed to identify and examine local, evidence-based activities that could be implemented within the breast cancer space in 2026.
The increase in OOH administration of Phesgo presents a significant opportunity for the healthcare system and patient experience. Commercially, it should act as a defence against future competitors and biosimilars in HER2+ Breast Cancer as the competition may place constraints on the healthcare system in terms of capacity and patient convenience.
The primary aim of this work within the Breast Cancer Squad is twofold: to consolidate existing evidence demonstrating the system benefit of using Phesgo and to provide a framework for expanding the value proposition to include the use of Phesgo in a homecare setting.
Scope and Deliverables: The scope of this work covers all local, evidence-based activities, including their utilisation for scientific dissemination (e.g., publication) and promotional materials.

- Organise a prioritisation exercise for evidence-based activities (i.e., local Integrated Evidence Plans (IEP)). This will provide direction for 2026 activities related to Phesgo adoption.
-Engage with healthcare sites and propose ways the Breast Cancer team can support the activation and dissemination of local data regarding Phesgo OOH adoption.
- Explore models (such as Budget Impact Models (BIM) or System Impact Models (SIM)) that could be offered to sites to highlight potential gains from Phesgo use.
-Potentially set up studies or a framework to accelerate local data analysis.

BACKGROUND & UNMET NEED
There is a need to improve knowledge of, and confidence in the lung cancer disease area, patient pathway, Tecentriq and competitor data in NSCLC & ES-SCLC, driven by:
1.  Newer additions to the squad, who are new to Tecentriq/Lung Cancer

A 2026 WP proposal has been made to address these requirements in the squad, in a formalised program, designed for MAPs, MPs, DLPs & other squad members wanting to learn. Specific individual knowledge gaps & needs will be identified in advance via confidential surveys. Knowledge & confidence will be benchmarked via surveys before, during & after. A blend of self-directed & facilitated learning will balance different learning styles, encourage participation & give flexibility for squad members.

The ambition is to improve knowledge & confidence of Lung Squad members in understanding the lung cancer therapy area, the patient pathway, immune checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies, Tecentriq indications and ph3 clinical trial data, and competitor clinical trial data in mNSCLC, ES-SCLC and ALK+ NSCLC.

Scientific, medical knowledge relating to lung cancer, immune checkpoint inhibitors & ALK TKIs
Relevant Tecentriq/Alecensa data, clinical trials & indications in esNSCLC, mNSCLC & ES-SCLC lung cancer 
Relevant competitor data, clinical trials & indications in esNSCLC, mNSCLC & ES-SCLC lung cancer

Other licensed/in-development molecules, treatment modalities in lung cancer

Vision & Opportunity: Our OneRoche vision is to prevent avoidable influenza deaths and protect healthcare systems. With the next UK antiviral tender likely in 2024, we aim to secure the inclusion of Xofluza in the national pandemic stockpile. As the only new MoA, single-oral-dose antiviral, Xofluza offers vital diversification—a key interest for DHSC and the Health Security Agency. The commercial potential is estimated at $\sim\mathcal{\textsterling}75\mathcal{\text{M}}-\mathcal{\textsterling}100\mathcal{\text{M}}$ (10% of the total stockpile). We will also explore discrete private market opportunities.

Objectives & Strategy: We aim to position Roche as the partner of choice for UK pandemic preparedness. Key activities include:

Developing a robust global/local pandemic pricing strategy and updating forecasts.

Engaging key external stakeholders to align with government plans (testing, treatment, delivery).

Building clinical advocacy and actively shaping the tender to be scored on value and support (e.g., Net Zero compliance, postal delivery) beyond just price.

Enabling stockpile diversification by offering Xofluza’s new MoA.

Exploring a comprehensive OneRoche offering (tests and treatment).

Mapping the full tender process and establishing a resilient supply chain approach for the UK and Northern Ireland protocol.

Deliverables & Benefits:

Deliverables: Stakeholder engagement plan, tender process map, creation of the UK pandemic offering, tender submission preparation, and defined DHSC/HSA ways of working.

Benefits: Patients gain access to a novel MoA; the System gains enhanced preparedness, a diverse stockpile, and potential for reduced hospitalisations; Roche secures a commercial opportunity and a key government partnership.

The scope focuses on the pandemic stockpile tender preparation. The project requires a core team of four 0.1 FTE members (Supply Chain, BDOP, Medical Affairs, Legal).

Objective: We will enable the current and future LGBTQ+ colleagues to feel seen, heard and understood following changes made as a result of this WP

We will design and implement a series of prioritised impactful actions by the end of 2025 that address identified gaps in the WEI, and benefit current and future LGBTQ+ colleagues within Roche UK (PD, Rx, and ideally Diagnostics). These actions will aim to:

Reflective Workforce: Build a workforce within Roche UK that mirrors the diversity of the societies we serve and supports LGBTQ+ employees to be themselves, perform at their best, and thrive.

Address Unmet Needs: Ensure our efforts meet the diverse needs of LGBTQ+ patients and communities.

Purpose/Background:
Roche UK has contracts with three wholesalers (Movianto in Northern Ireland; AAH Pharmaceuticals and Alliance Healthcare in Great Britain) dating back to 2015 and 2018. Select wholesalers that best meet the needs of UK hospitals and pharmacies, and negotiate terms that benefit the UK organization and provide operational advantages.

Wholesaling services across Great Britain. Northern Ireland is excluded as it is a distinct market well-served by Movianto, who distributes all Roche products there. Patients: Availability of medicines

Roche: Compliance with legal directives/requirements, data availability, potential to simplify rebates and distribution fee setup, potential to remove discounts/save on distribution fees

items.description:
There are 2 main objectives of the work:
Evolve the PRPC Operating Model & Ways of Working to reflect PRPCs expanded accountability for the strategic commissioning of above-brand system shaping work. This will be realised through a refinement of PRPC rituals and the establishment of 'Minimum Standards'. By clarifying these new connection points and streamlining governance, we will remove operational noise and ensure the cluster is a high-performing unit that ensures our access and system-shaping efforts are both impactful and scalable.
Strategically embed the Access Strategy Lead (ASL) and Access Innovation Lead (AIL) roles into the UK Operating Model by December 2026. This will be realised through a structured, phased approach: first, by establishing internal alignment on the value chain and interface maps to ensure seamless boundary management; then, transitioning into the delivery of high-caliber onboarding and capacity building. The outcome will be a system where these roles are not merely integrated, but fully optimised and driving our commercialisation milestones and patient access goals.

items.description:
Purpose
To ensure the i8 Commercial Leads Community operates smoothly, continues to evolve in the right direction, and is effectively supported to achieve its objectives.

Scope & Key Activities

Agenda management: Design and coordinate meeting agendas in close alignment with community priorities and leadership input.

Meeting follow-up: Capture decisions, actions, and owners, and ensure timely follow-up and closure.

Best practice sharing: Enable systematic sharing of best practices, insights, and learnings across the community.

Knowledge management: Ensure materials, outputs, and resources are stored in the appropriate, agreed locations and are easy to access.

Community enablement: Provide operational support to help the community focus on value-adding discussions rather than logistics.

Intended Outcomes

Well-structured, purposeful meetings with clear outcomes.

Improved follow-through on actions and decisions.

Increased visibility and reuse of best practices across markets.

A well-supported, continuously improving community that can focus on strategic and commercial priorities.

Value to the Community
This work package creates the operational backbone that allows the i8 Commercial Leads Community to function efficiently, collaborate effectively, and continuously strengthen its impact.

- By the end of August 2026 we expect to identify and report local use cases of practical and/or impactful solutions to be shared into the Global Knowledge Management AI repository, positioning Peru as a contributor of scalable experiences. Metric: 1 to 3 uses cases 
- During the cycle (May-Aug 2026) we aim to deploy global solutions or experiences to simplify local operations. Metrics: 1 to 3 experiences
Rewarding
To foster the leverage and replication of available solutions/experiences, and also to incentivize the definition of new valuable solutions, we will propose contests including Applause awards.

subitems: KO 5- Desarrollo de Plan de Acción
items.description:
Our goal is to master key account management alignment, concentrating both impact and metrics on maximizing the benefit to the therapeutic area. We aim to enhance planning (STO and MTO) through the redefinition of key performance indicators (KPIs), thereby ensuring better stewardship of PJP and squad teams and a more effective allocation of resources
Cultural and Barrier Removal: We repaired physician trust by acknowledging past failures and secured local/global leadership buy-in to push for an agile, Ophthalmology-specific way of working, embracing the discomfort of change.
Market Strategy Refinement: The strategy was adapted to position Vabysmo as the "First Choice," focusing the commercial narrative heavily on First Line (1L) adoption and switching.
Execution and Efficiency: We drove efficiency by redefining PJP competitiveness and simplifying operations (e.g., reducing cycle meetings and enforcing end-of-year Account Planning). This ensured a superior and disciplined field execution that delivered the commitment to all stakeholders.

Implement Icobrain in key high-volume centers across the LATAM region to trigger treatment switches from low-efficacy therapies to high-efficacy therapies by optimizing clinical decision-making. The initiative aims to leverage pilots in selected hospitals to generate relevant local real-world evidence, foster data-driven clinical practices, and promote evidence-based peer-to-peer sharing of successful outcomes to expand adoption across LATAM.

Identify and empower high-potential local HCP leaders (“Rising Stars”) aligned with Ocrevus’ strategic goals by providing tailored educational and professional development. The initiative will be conducted in two phases: first, a scientfic exchange at a Brazilian Center of Excellence in late Q1 to provide foundational knowledge, followed by a LATAM-wide webinar on emerging criteria for MS management, the role of biomarkers, and subsequent follow-up discussions. Selected preceptorship participants will be featured as speakers during the webinar to enhance their regional visibility.

Develop a formal expert consensus on the value of early treatment with high-efficacy therapies  in relapsing-remitting MS. The aim is to drive early adoption of HET treatments, shift the mindset of the LATAM MS scientific community, and position Ocrevus as a pivotal therapy during key decision-making points about treatment.

Develop a LATAM-wide always-on content strategy and omnichannel communication plan to deliver targeted messages that focus on Ocrevus' differentiation versus competitors and reinforce the robustness of its experience. This initiative will address key themes such as pregnancy and breastfeeding, comparative results against competitors, 11 years of Ocrevus data (11Y OCR), and positioning messages in the market. A second phase will introduce materials aimed at deeper differentiation from competitors

Transform the campaign "Pintando una nueva cara de la EM" into a continuous regional disease awareness initiative. The focus is to organize a regional BTL (Below-the-Line) activity with various local activations, complemented by three educational webinars in collaboration with PAGs (Patient Advocacy Groups). These efforts aim to raise awareness about MS, foster stronger collaboration with PAGs/NGOs, and enhance education and visibility of MS challenges across LATAM.

Segment the customer base through prioritization of profiles and the implementation of Customer Personas to develop personalized strategies that increase commercial impact and enhance the customer experience

items.description: Collect, synthesize, and validate the scientific and real-world evidence needed to build a persuasive narrative that empowers PPOCs. This narrative will focus on specific eligible patient subgroups for Hemlibra, in order to educate healthcare professionals, drive clinical adoption, and expand access to therapy within affiliates.

Design and implement a regional engagement and education forum for key payers and health authorities in Latin America during C2 2026, in order to provide robust pharmacoeconomic evidence and novel clinical data on treatment options in Hemophilia (including Hemlibra), ensuring that at least 70% of attendees report a greater understanding of the long-term value of innovative treatments and use this information to improve or expand coverage of the eligible population in the coming months.

Regional exchange and medical education event for leading hemophilia experts (HCPs), to explore the latest evidence that supports treatment decisions, focusing on "beyond ABR". The focus will be on data related to joint health and quality of life for comprehensive patient management.

To evaluate Hemlibra's positioning among hematologists in Latin America and its differentiation from existing or soon-to-be-launched hemophilia therapies, based on the framework of the BEST narrative. The goal of the project is to obtain key insights that can help the team to take corrective actions or opportunities to improve the brand's regional strategy. Additionally, the MR seeks to identify barriers, gaps, and opportunities in the comprehensive management of hemophilia in the countries of the region.

Drive Hemlibra's exponential growth by addressing the changing market dynamics and increasing competitive threats. It aims to equip affiliates with skills and knowledge within their field teams, enabling them to address local market dynamics and competitive pressures.

Establish a Pure Digital strategy to expand the reach of Hemlibra BEST narrative and key messages to specialist segments with low or no field visits. This initiative will ensure that the key audience receives information on joint health management and the role of decentralization in comprehensive patient care.

The Hemlibra auto-injector is our next step in ensuring an excellent customer experience for people with hemophilia using Hemlibra. The launch will be challenging due to the proximity of competitor launches and the introduction of new dosage bands. Proper preparation is required to ensure a smooth and rapid launch while supporting our competitive positioning.

Vidas Extraordinarias movement aims to: - Provide tools, knowledge, and links that empower the hemophilia patient and caregiver network, leading to improvements in the quality of life for people with hemophilia A.
- Raise awareness about scientific innovation that promote comprehensive care for hemophilia A in Latin America.
- Connect the hemophilia A community and their support networks to join forces for a life free from hemophilia burdens .
